responsibility: Contains the crate’s root-level unit tests for basic rustc_abi invariants, currently validating core alignment constants and constructors exposed by the public ABI/layout utility types.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `src/extern_abi/tests.rs`, this `tests.rs` covers crate-root `rustc_abi` primitives directly—currently `Align` constants/construction—rather than the nested `extern_abi` module’s ABI string lookup behavior and table/index consistency.
